reviews.x: Better than expected.  Didn’t know what to expect for under $5.  But I was pleasantly surprised!  Received exactly as described and pictured.  Packaged each individually in sealed plastic bags all in a nice big white gift box.  This were perfect!  They are sturdy and held up my thick curly hair.  The size is perfect for sides.  They didn’t hurt and surprising didn’t break like other have after moving them around several times.  I would say I would order more, but there were so many in the pack.

reviews.t: Just like the good old days!
reviews.x: I couldn't believe how hard it was to find hair combs like the ones from when I was a kid in the 70s - The kind that actually held your hair in place! I have really thick hair, so I love that these combs don't break easily. Another plus is that they don't pull your hair out.

I have fine thin hair.  These combs do great job of holding my hair in place without the combs slipping around whether I'm using them for an updo or for use as side combs.  Very pleased with these.  Would recommend!

These combs arrived arranged by color in a little box, individually wrapped so they wouldnt get tangled. I love the variety of colors. The teeth are a little sharp but not bad. Just use care pushing them in and they don't hurt afterwards. The extra little teeth hold my fine hair well and stay in well.
Each comb came individually wrapped.  What a nice touch. It came in a white gift box. I wear my hair natural so I am excited to create a fro hawk using the combs.

reviews.t: perfectly easy styling with these combs
reviews.x: Precisely as described.  These comes work beautifully interlocking and styling  my hair.  Price is right and the assortment is perfect.
Breaks very easy... would not buy again. They are useless.🥺

In the photos shown, the company advertises you'll get twelve combs in black, clear and brown. This isn't the case. I got three clear and nine brown combs. So I'll keep them and get use out of them until they break, but I'll not be purchasing from this company again.
I have thick hair; bought these thinking the tines would hold in the hair but the plastic's hard, not bendable, and the tines broke on both ends first day; I would not recommend this product
Nice combs for price.  Just what i wanted.

reviews.t: Beautiful combs, nicely packed. Perfect for fine hair.
reviews.x: These are exactly what I needed. I have fine but very silky textured hair, and it’s growing during quarantine. French twists were my go-to style when I worked and needed a quick updo to get out the door. These are super easy to use and have great holding abilities. Plus, they come individually wrapped and in a pretty box. I appreciate the little things. I’m sure 4 combs would’ve been plenty, but now I can share with my daughters.

These combs really do fasten and stay fastened with little to no pressure. The color assortment adds value to the product price. I love the "upsweep" hairdos that I can make with these. Now I hardly ever wear elastics I highly recommend this set of combs  to anyone tired of tight elastics, and who wants to experiment with this way of making hairdos.

I was initially pleased with my combs, i have thin hair. They hold. But they break. and they break and they break. Spend your money on a french comb.  They cost a little more but they are sturdy and kind to your hair
The teeth break off easily. My hair is not thick, so they just aren't made well. I've broken 4 or 5 already. I do not recommend these.

reviews.t: They work for fine, thin hair.
reviews.x: Just received these today, but I am already impressed.  I have had fineAND thin hair my entire life.  Over the years, My hair has gotten so thin that I use only one small (1.3”) snap hair clip to hold all my top and side hair up on the back of my head.  I put one of these combs in and it has held securely for the past 4-5 hours!  Wonderful! The combs come in a nice small white box.  Great for gift wrapping.  In addition, EACH comb is in an individually sealed, clear plastic wrapper.  You could k

reviews.t: I'm taking it back to the old school....
reviews.x: When I was a teen in the 80s and then my mom a young mom in the 70s, hair combs were the thing. There are so many in the box. Now hair combs back in my younger days were definitely made better but those broke too. These are not heavy duty but unless you're heavy handed I don't see why they won't last a very long time. Also, there are so many that you have replacements over and over. Totally worth the price.

Didn't realize how many I was getting...but it's just more bang for my bucks. They are various colors and pretty much stay in your hair. I did have to reapply them off and on during the day. but I'm older, have thinning hair and haven't needed something like this in years. So, maybe I'm not using them correctly, but I love them. I'd buy them again but I think I currently have plenty!

I have baby fine hair.  Most of the time a purchase like this gets "re-gifted" for that reason.  My baby hair usuaally won't allow anything like this to stay in place (not even little baby barretts..) These are great.  They hug my scalp, and won't shake loose. My hair is securely held in place without having to use any product (hair glue)

I didn’t understand why there were 3 of each kind. I would have preferred 3 colors and had 4 of each kind. They do seem to stay in my hair better than combs without teeth. My hair is fine so I believe they will work.

reviews.t: side combs that do not do what they are supposed to do
reviews.x: The quality of these side combs feel sturdy, however, they do not hold the hair as they should. The comb kept falling out. I used it may be once, and that was it.
I use these combs often. They hold my hair all day. Other combs, do not stay in, or break easily. So far so good.

reviews.t: hair clips stay in hair and keep hair in place
reviews.x: These clips are the perfect colors, sturdy, and keep my thick hair in place. good quality at a good price.
These work really, really well even with fine hair. So glad I found them.
Even better than expected. Holds hair perfectly! Very satisfied
These combs are absolutely perfect for thin hair!!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the combs hold their hair well, especially for fine or thin hair.
Several reviewers praise the packaging, noting each comb is individually wrapped and comes in a gift box.
A notable number of reviewers report the combs break easily, particularly the teeth.
Reviewers appreciate the variety of colors and the low price.
One reviewer received a different color assortment than advertised.
